name: amanah/services-feature
title: Service feature
description: One service as a full section: eyebrow, headline (wrap words in <em> for red), text, price, bullet list and buttons beside a visual. The visual is a photo (with an optional chip), or, with no photo, a stack of rows adding up to a total; either can carry a live line graphic (net = fibre with packets, conv = carriers converging on your rack) above a grid of networks. Turn on Paper for the light surface and Flip to put the visual on the left. Bullets, stack and networks are lists edited in the code editor.

text.default: Rent Dell PowerEdge servers month to month, racked next to your own gear at 151 Front. Add capacity for a project without buying hardware you will outgrow.

default: Month to month, no long commitment
